data.one_liner: A collection of opinionated lint rules for Dart and Flutter projects.
data.what_it_does: Provides a set of strict, community‑driven lint rules that enforce the Effective Dart style guide. It can replace the older pedantic or lints packages with a more comprehensive rule set.
use_when: Enforce coding style in production apps
Run CI checks for code quality
avoid_when: Very small scripts or prototypes that need minimal linting
Projects that already use a different lint configuration and cannot merge rules
strengths: Supports multiple rule sets (strict, casual, package)
weaknesses: May be too strict for some teams
data.setup_notes: Add dev_dependencies: lint: ^2.0.0 and include package:lint/strict.yaml in analysis_options.yaml

alternatives.name: lints
alternatives.why_pick_it: Official Dart linter rules with a more permissive default set
